detail.longDescription:
ToolNeuron - Offline AI App for Android
Run powerful AI models directly on your Android device. No internet required. No data collection. Complete privacy.
🤖 OFFLINE AI ASSISTANT

Chat with AI using Large Language Models (GGUF: Llama, Mistral, Gemma)
Generate images with Stable Diffusion 1.5
All AI processing happens offline on your device
Switch between text and image AI in the same conversation
No cloud servers, no internet dependency after model download

🏪 MODEL STORE

Browse curated GGUF models and SD 1.5 checkpoints
Add HuggingFace repositories to list available models
Load custom local models without storage permissions
One-tap installation with progress tracking
Model configuration editor for advanced tuning

🔐 MILITARY-GRADE SECURITY

Hardware-backed AES-256-GCM encryption (Android KeyStore)
All conversations and images encrypted at rest
Write-Ahead Logging prevents data corruption
LZ4 compression reduces storage usage
Zero telemetry, analytics, or tracking

💬 UNIFIED AI CHAT

Single chat interface for text and image generation
Full conversation history with text + images preserved
Advanced search: full-text and semantic vector search
Tag and organize your AI conversations
Export conversations and generated content

⚙️ ADVANCED FEATURES

Model Configuration Editor: tune temperature, context length, top-k, top-p
Custom model support: import any GGUF or SD 1.5 model
Content deduplication saves storage
Memory-efficient three-tier caching (3-5MB during use)
Encrypted memory system with crash recovery

⚡ OPTIMIZED PERFORMANCE

Faster AI inference (users report 7-second responses for 8B models)
Reduced memory consumption
Better battery efficiency than cloud AI apps
Optimized model loading and switching

🛡️ YOUR PRIVACY MATTERS

100% offline AI processing (no cloud after download)
No account or login required
Open-source and auditable on GitHub
Your data never leaves your device
No subscriptions or paywalls

📋 REQUIREMENTS

Android 8.0+
6GB RAM minimum (8GB+ for image generation)
5-15GB free storage for AI models

🎯 USE CASES

Private AI conversations and journaling
Creative writing and brainstorming
Code generation and debugging offline
AI image creation and artistic exploration
Secure AI for sensitive data (medical, legal, personal)

🔮 COMING SOON

RAG system: inject documents for context-aware responses
Text-to-Speech (TTS) and Speech-to-Text (STT)
Plugin system for AI tools

💡 WHY TOOLNEURON?
Unlike cloud-based AI apps (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini), ToolNeuron gives you complete control. Your AI conversations, images, and data stay on your device, encrypted and private. No subscriptions, no data mining, no compromises.
Perfect for:
✓ Privacy-conscious users who need offline AI
✓ Developers and AI researchers
✓ Creative professionals using AI tools
✓ Healthcare and legal professionals
✓ Anyone in areas with limited internet
✓ Users who value data sovereignty
📱 OPEN SOURCE
ToolNeuron is open-source (Apache 2.0). Audit the code, contribute features, or build your own version.
⚠️ IMPORTANT

AI models are large (500MB - 10GB+). WiFi recommended.
Performance depends on your device hardware.
You are responsible for content generated using AI models.

💬 SUPPORT

GitHub: github.com/Siddhesh2377/ToolNeuron
Discord: discord.gg/mVPwHDhrAP
Email: siddheshsonar2377@gmail.com

Download ToolNeuron today and experience true offline AI on Android.
No internet required after model download.
No data collection. Ever.
No subscriptions. Free forever.
Your AI. Your data. Your device.
